fields.description: Turn on to let the scheduler send follow-up templates. Nothing is sent while this is off.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Add every WhatsApp conversation to the sequence automatically.
fields.label: Auto Enroll

fields.description: Draft for approval notifies the assigned agent instead of sending.
fields.label: Send Mode

fields.description: A send that falls in the quiet window is deferred, never cancelled.
fields.label: Quiet Hours Start

fields.description: Maximum follow-up messages per day across all leads. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Daily Send Cap

fields.description: Do not enroll a conversation whose last message is older than this. It stops the first run from draining a months-old backlog. 0 means no bound.
fields.label: Ignore Conversations Idle Longer Than (days)

fields.description: One keyword per line. A reply that contains one stops the sequence for good.
fields.label: Stop Keywords

fields.description: Silence days are counted from the previous message, so 2 / 2 / 2 fires on day 2, day 4 and day 6.
fields.label: Stages
